title: Software Engineer - Supply Chain, ERP | 4 to 8 yrs - BLR
teaser: We are seeking a Software Engineer to drive innovation in Cisco’s Supply Chain IT systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, architect and develop ERP solutions, and solve complex business challenges. Ideal candidates have strong software development expertise and experience in Agile environments.
description:
Meet the Team

Join the Supply Chain Plan IT at Cisco and help drive innovation in our Supply Chain IT systems. We’re seeking creative, passionate individuals ready for new challenges and eager to make a significant impact. As part of the team, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, influence global operations, and help build the future of Cisco’s supply chain. We value fresh perspectives, foster a culture of collaboration and continuous learning, and prioritize work-life balance. If you’re ready to use your skills to solve real-world challenges and be part of something bigger, we want you on our team.

Your Impact

• An experienced Software Engineer with domain expertise and a passion for solving complex business problems.

• Possesses strong communication and collaboration skills, essential for cross-functional team success.

• An expert in the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and agile engineering practices, staying current with industry trends.

• Collaborates effectively with Product Owners/Business Analysts and multi-functional teams to architect, design, develop, test, and release high-quality features.

• A skilled troubleshooter who performs root cause analysis and implements fixes for complex production issues.

• Applies best practices, business insight, and independent problem-solving to continuously elevate products and services.

• A mentor who supports team members and fosters a culture of learning, inclusion, and collaboration.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years, Master’s with 3+ years of relevant experience

• Experience in Supply Chain ERP (E-Business Suite 11i, R12) Modules -Advanced supply chain planning (ASCP) ,Order Management and customization is a plus

• Proficient in SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle Workflow, and web service integration.

• Strong understanding of Angular, React, Java, Spring Boot, REST Apis, Node.js and Python

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps

• Practical experience using GenAI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to accelerate development work

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Preferred Qualifications

• Working experience on Prompt engineering, LLMs, RAG / AI-assisted automation

• Relevant certifications in Java, Oracle, Cloud technologies, AWS, and AI/ML.

• Experience with cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, and Azure

• Proficiency in Generative AI (Gen AI Green Belt), MCP tools and Data Science & Security Green Belts

• Strong understanding of  containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience with Oracle, MongoDB, and Snowflake databases

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
